title: Sunlit 2BHK Apartment
description: A quiet second-floor 2BHK on a tree-lined lane off North Main Road. Wooden flooring in both bedrooms, a north-facing balcony that stays cool through summer, and covered parking for one car. Five minutes' walk to Osho Garden.

title: 3BHK with River-Facing Balcony
description: Ninth-floor 3BHK in a gated society along the Mula-Mutha, with an uninterrupted river-facing balcony. Modular kitchen, two dedicated parking spots, and a clubhouse with a pool. Ready to move, clear title.

title: Compact Studio Near IT Park
description: A tidy fully-furnished studio ten minutes from EON IT Park by bike. Bed, wardrobe, work desk, and kitchenette included. Ideal for a single working professional. Society has a small gym and a generator backup.
